forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: A cycle means two modules are really one; merge them or move the shared part down.

forbidden.name: no-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: An import the resolver can't find would slip past every other rule.

forbidden.name: shared-is-a-leaf
forbidden.comment: packages/shared holds the zod schemas and pure logic both apps use; it imports neither app.

forbidden.name: widgets-never-import-server
forbidden.comment: Widgets run in the agent's iframe; they get data through tool results and packages/shared types, never server code.

forbidden.name: server-never-imports-widgets
forbidden.comment: The server serves the built widgets from disk (WOVAIN_WIDGETS_DIR); it doesn't import their source.

forbidden.name: lib-below-tools
forbidden.comment: apps/server/src/lib is the layer under the MCP tools and playbooks; it never reaches up into them.

forbidden.name: tools-dont-import-tools
forbidden.comment: Each tool file stands alone; logic two tools share belongs in lib/ or packages/shared.

forbidden.name: no-test-code-in-src
forbidden.comment: Production code never imports tests, stories or mocks.
